. That's exactly the reported symptom — everything slow, nothing erroring, health green. A confirming probe 8.5 minutes later (994ms on `/products/1`, vs. <2ms pre-toggle) showed it was still active at the time of writing.

Resource saturation and a code-level defect were both tested and ruled out — no RSS growth or restart, zero exceptions in the full log history, and the slowdown hit unrelated routes simultaneously rather than one data-dependent path.

No remediation was applied (read-only investigation, per the lab boundary) — turning the switch off is an operator action outside this scope.
